brief:
Amnesty International released a report documenting that Israel has inflicted repeated and cumulative harms on women and girls in Gaza since October 2023 as part of its ongoing genocide against Palestinians. The organization characterized these harms as deliberate and systematic.

The report examines the pattern of violence and suffering experienced by Gaza's female population throughout the conflict that began last year.
dek: Israel has relentlessly inflicted repeated and cumulative harms on women and girls in the occupied Gaza Strip since October 2023 as an integral part of its ongoing genocide against Palestinians, said Amnesty International in a new report published today.
title: Amnesty says Israel targets Gaza women, girls as genocide tactic
